name: Additional LEI Attributes
definition: Additional LEI attributes belonging to the LEI of an organisation.

RelationshipType.name: Relationship Type
RelationshipType.definition: Unique code designating the specific category of a directional relationship between two legal entities.

RelationshipStatus.name: Relationship Status
RelationshipStatus.definition: Status of the legal entities' relationship itself: ACTIVE or INACTIVE.

ManagingLOU.name: Managing LOU
ManagingLOU.definition: LEI of the LEI Issuer that is responsible for administering this LEI Record.

RelatedOrganisationIdentification.name: Related Organisation Identification
RelatedOrganisationIdentification.definition: Identification of the organisation for wich the LEI attributes belongs to.
